blocks.html: The aggregate floor area of Group H occupancies located in an unlimited area building shall not exceed 10 percent of the area of the building and shall not exceed the area limitations for the Group H occupancies as specified in Section 506 based on the perimeter of each Group H floor area that fronts on a public way or open space.
